SELECT cr.id, cr.real_name AS realName, cr.craft_type AS craftType, cr.inheritance, cr.intro, cr.cover, cr.follower_count AS followerCount, IFNULL(g.cnt, 0) AS goodsCount FROM craftsman cr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT craftsman_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM goods WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND audit_status = 1 GROUP BY craftsman_id ) g ON g.craftsman_id = cr.id WHERE cr.deleted = 0 AND cr.audit_status = 1
AND cr.craft_type = #{q.craftType}
AND (cr.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR cr.craft_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR cr.intro LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY cr.follower_count DESC, cr.id ASC ORDER BY goodsCount DESC, cr.id ASC ORDER BY cr.id DESC ORDER BY cr.follower_count DESC, cr.id ASC

SELECT cr.id, cr.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.create_time AS registerTime, cr.real_name AS realName, cr.id_card_no AS idCardNo, cr.cert_image AS certImage, cr.craft_type AS craftType, cr.inheritance, cr.intro, cr.resume, cr.cover, cr.audit_status AS auditStatus, cr.reject_reason AS rejectReason, cr.audit_time AS auditTime, cr.follower_count AS followerCount, cr.create_time AS createTime FROM craftsman cr JOIN `user` u ON u.id = cr.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE cr.deleted = 0 AND cr.id = #{id}
